title: Ex 1.2 #6 · {x ∈ ℝ : x² = x} × {x ∈ ℕ : x² = x}
prompt: List the elements of $\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x^2 = x\} \times \{x \in \mathbb{N} : x^2 = x\}$ between braces. (Steps may call the two factors $A$ and $B$, in that order.)
answer_format: A set of ordered pairs between braces, like {(1, a), (2, b)}. Spaces are optional. Steps are optional.
hints: x² = x means x(x − 1) = 0. Which of the solutions are natural numbers?
Then pair each element of the first factor with each element of the second: 2 pairs in all.
solution: The first factor is $A = \{0, 1\}$ and the second is $B = \{1\}$.
Pair each element of A with each element of B.
